comments.author: juliusmarr
comments.body: The stale-while-revalidate flag is read but never consulted, so entries flagged stale keep serving until the full TTL instead of refreshing in the background. The flag check is simply missing from the lookup path.

comments.author: nadinebohl
comments.body: Good catch — wired the flag into the lookup, added a regression test asserting background refresh on stale entries, green run 5120. Nothing further needed on this thread.
